hero.description: Based in Montréal, with {years}+ years shipping production web and mobile apps in React, React Native, TypeScript and Node.js. Lately, I build AI agents that work inside real products. Fluent in French and English.

contact.description1: I'm always open to discussing new opportunities, interesting projects, or just having a chat about technology.
contact.description2: Feel free to reach out through any of the channels below!

aboutMe.bioDescription1: I’m a full-stack developer at Civalgo, where I build the web platform and the React Native app that 1,300 people use every week. I care about the parts that make software trustworthy: fast load times, sync that never loses data, and incidents fixed in minutes instead of days.
aboutMe.bioDescription2: Some results I’m proud of: the mobile app now opens in 3 seconds instead of 5 minutes, updates sent from the job site fail 6 times less often, and the company’s AI assistant went from a hackathon idea to production. Outside work, I co-founded FlyerAlerte, a Québec grocery price comparison engine, and run my own Kubernetes homelab.
aboutMe.bioDescription3: I’m fluent in French and English. If you need someone who owns features end to end, from the database to the screen, let’s talk.
aboutMe.hobby1Description: Playing Smash Bros with my friends is always a fun time. The strategy and adaptability needed to compete keep the game entertaining.
aboutMe.hobby2Description: Performing a song on my guitar is something I enjoy doing in my free time. The time and focus required to learn each song sharpen my concentration and attention to detail.
aboutMe.hobby3Description: Participating in hackathons is always thrilling. I enjoy learning new technologies, solving problems quickly, and working with a team.

skill.proficientDescription: Confident building and maintaining production systems with this tech. Can design solutions, troubleshoot complex issues, and mentor others.
skill.intermediateDescription: Regularly used this tech to deliver features with some autonomy, comfortable debugging and extending existing code.
skill.familiarDescription: Used in prototypes or small projects; can read and modify code with guidance. May not have shipped large-scale systems.
skill.learningDescription: Recently started exploring the technology (courses, tutorials, toy projects). Not yet relied upon in production.
